authorship_note: Every control's text is independently hand-authored for this milestone, synthetic and generic -- never copied from any real job posting (same discipline as M11-G6's corpus). Safe to commit in full, including verbatim text.
correction_log: Pre-freeze verification (via m11g7_preflight_check.py, run BEFORE the hash freeze -- learned from M11-G6's post-freeze correction rounds) caught and fixed, before any freeze: (a) m11g7-007's word count (10->9, a manual counting error) and its expected_heading_kind (UNKNOWN->REQUIRED, corrected after directly executing _matched_heading_families on the real text rather than assuming a two-family collision that does not actually occur); (b) m11g7-018/019/020/021/030/031's top-level heading_word_count/has_strong_shape_signal fields described the WRONG heading (the embedded, second, defect-triggering heading inside body_lines) instead of heading_line itself -- corrected to describe heading_line consistently, with the second heading's own word count stated in prose instead; (c) m11g7-021 was authored as a 'positive control' claiming an 8-word second heading was 'already recognized today' without verifying this directly -- direct execution showed it was ALSO defective (8 > 7); replaced with a genuinely-verified 6-word heading (confirmed to already resolve correctly today) so this control tests what it was always meant to test (clean transition behavior once a heading IS recognized), with the 8-word defect shape now covered properly by m11g7-030 instead; (d) m11g7-038/042's word counts (13->12, manual counting errors). A SECOND pre-freeze round, caught by batch-verifying every distinct heading-like string against `_matched_heading_families` directly rather than assuming: the phrase 'What You Will Be Able To Build And Own' (used across controls 004/008/009/010/023/035 and embedded in several severity-tier controls) does NOT match `_RESPONSIBILITY_ROOT` at all -- that root requires the bare word 'respons*', 'duties'/'duty', the EXACT phrase 'what you'll do'/'what you will do', 'the role', or 'day in this role'; 'build and own' matches none of these. Corrected expected_heading_kind from RESPONSIBILITY to UNKNOWN for all six. m11g7-022 (the same phrase, em-dash terminated, weak shape signal) has zero family AND weak signal, so it correctly stays NOT_A_HEADING under ANY G7 fix -- corrected from RESPONSIBILITY. m11g7-025's 'A Little More About Our Company...' does NOT trigger `_NON_QUALIFICATION_ROOT`'s `^about\b` (anchored to the literal FIRST character, 'A', not 'About') -- corrected from SKIP to UNKNOWN. m11g7-038's 'What You Will Be Responsible For' DOES match the bare `respons*` root (a broader alternative than 'what you'll do' that an earlier draft missed) -- corrected from UNKNOWN to RESPONSIBILITY. No control's SAFETY-RELEVANT expected outcome (which lines must never be scored, which must never be silently lost) was changed by any of these corrections -- all were either pure label/field-scope fixes or corrections to match directly-verified, pre-existing, unrelated behavior.

schema_notes.body_qualifications.should_enter_assessm: Asymmetric by design, matching the two DIFFERENT safety invariants this milestone measures: for a genuine qualification (is_genuine_qualification=true), True means 'must be admitted as AT LEAST a diagnostic claim (a JobRequirement OR an UnparsedClaim) -- never silently, totally dropped' (the HIGH_silent_total_suppression risk). For a non-qualification (is_genuine_qualification=false), False means 'must NEVER become a SCORED JobRequirement' (the HIGH_fabricated_assessable_requirement risk) -- it says nothing about whether the line may still, safely, appear as a diagnostic UnparsedClaim (confirmed, by direct execution, to be the existing, safe, intended behavior for RESPONSIBILITY-section content with no local marker). Exact diagnostic-admission COUNTS are a Phase 1/4 MEASUREMENT against the real pipeline, not a gold prediction -- learned directly from an authoring error caught before this freeze (see correction_log).
schema_notes.expected_heading_kind: Gold answer for what the heading_line SHOULD resolve to under a correct, safe fix -- real _SectionKind enum member names (REQUIRED/PREFERRED/RESPONSIBILITY/LEARNING/SKIP/UNKNOWN) or NOT_A_HEADING (should never be recognized as a heading at all, under ANY safe fix -- the adversarial/weak-signal controls).
schema_notes.severity_tier: For carry-forward scenario controls only: the measured severity of what happens if this specific defect instance is left unfixed -- LOW_diagnostic_only (never scored), HIGH_fabricated_assessable_requirement (confirmed to produce a non-None alignment_score from non-qualification prose), or HIGH_silent_total_suppression (confirmed to silently drop a genuine, locally-marked REQUIRED claim entirely). null for controls not testing a carry-forward scenario.
